highlights: AI agents are rapidly advancing towards practical real-world deployment, with Anthropic introducing a standard for safe physical device interaction and Google enhancing agent training environments for adaptive learning.

OpenAI showcases robust commercial growth, hitting a $1 billion annualized revenue run rate for ChatGPT Ads, alongside strategic advancements in custom inference hardware with their new Jalapeño chip.

The open-source community is significantly empowering builders, delivering a high-performance WebGPU library for AI agent shaders and an affordable, open-source bipedal robot platform for reinforcement learning.

agents.title: Anthropic Opens a Research Preview of the Model Hardware Standard (MHS)
agents.summary: Anthropic unveiled MHS, a shared driver specification enabling AI agents to safely discover and operate physical devices, drastically reducing instrument integration time from weeks to hours.

agents.title: Google AI Introduces EnvHarness: Adaptive Training Worlds for Agents
agents.summary: Google AI released EnvHarness, an Apache-2.0 programmable layer that transforms static agent benchmarks into adaptive training environments, improving skill acquisition and reducing execution steps.

agents.title: WM-R1: Training GUI Agents with World Models and RL
agents.summary: WM-R1 is a novel reinforcement learning framework for mobile GUI agents that trains with world models instead of real environments, significantly reducing resource costs and improving stability by embedding world models directly into the agent's reasoning process.

models.title: Google AI Releases Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash: Scene Extension, Frame Control, and 4K Upscaling
models.summary: Google's Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash enhances multimodal video generation and editing with up to 40-second scene extension, precise first/last frame control, and 4K upscaling, offering greater creative flexibility.

models.title: Nemotron 3.5 Content Safety Moderator: Compact, Multimodal, Multilingual Safety Model
models.summary: Nemotron 3.5 CS is a compact 4B vision-language safety moderator that classifies prompts, images, and responses across 12 languages, providing safety labels and optional reasoning traces for custom policy enforcement.

models.title: Advancing price-performance for developers with GPT‑5.6 in Kiro
models.summary: OpenAI has made GPT‑5.6 available in Kiro, offering developers improved price-performance for planning, building, reviewing, and testing software.

tools.title: Vercel AI Open-Sources vgpu: A TypeScript WebGPU Library for AI Agent Shaders
tools.summary: Vercel released vgpu, an open-source TypeScript WebGPU library that simplifies the use of shaders for AI agents in web environments, enabling performant graphics and deterministic testing across platforms.

tools.title: OpenClaw Releases OpenClaw 2.0: Guided Model Setup and Faster Control UI
tools.summary: OpenClaw 2.0 brings significant enhancements including guided model setup, a drastically faster Control UI startup (575 ms), and introduces shared cloud sessions, improving collaboration and developer experience.

tools.title: Hugging Face Unveils Microduck: A $399 Open-Source RL Biped Robot
tools.summary: Hugging Face, through Pollen Robotics, launched Microduck, a $399 open-source bipedal robot for reinforcement learning, making sim-to-real robotics research accessible with a full training stack and hardware.

companies.title: OpenAI: ChatGPT Ads Reaches $1 Billion Annualized Revenue
companies.summary: OpenAI's ChatGPT Ads has achieved a $1 billion annualized revenue run rate, demonstrating significant commercial success and enabling broader access to AI through its free and affordable options globally.

companies.title: OpenAI's Jalapeño Chip Shows Industry-Leading AI Inference Speed and Efficiency
companies.summary: OpenAI announced first results for Jalapeño, their custom inference chip, showcasing superior speed and power efficiency for AI inference, promising higher throughput and lower latency for modern models.

companies.title: OpenAI Supports Thailand’s Next Generation of AI Startups
companies.summary: OpenAI, in partnership with Thailand's MHESI, launched an eight-week accelerator program to help 10 health, wellness, and education startups develop AI prototypes into trusted products, fostering local AI innovation.

learning.title: Google AI's 353,000-Person AI Agents Intensive Coding Course
learning.summary: Kaggle's free AI Agents Intensive, powered by Google, successfully brought together over 350,000 learners to build and deploy the next generation of AI agents, fostering a massive community of AI builders.

learning.title: Building Custom Batched Ensemble Weather Forecasting with NVIDIA Earth2Studio
learning.summary: This tutorial provides a practical guide on constructing an ensemble weather forecasting workflow using NVIDIA Earth2Studio, covering installation, model loading, data retrieval, and custom diagnostic implementation for real-world applications.

learning.title: Training and Finetuning Multi-Vector Embedding Models with Sentence Transformers
learning.summary: This guide delves into the advanced techniques for training and fine-tuning multi-vector embedding models using Sentence Transformers, providing builders with methods to enhance semantic search and retrieval performance.
